preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 20000, inclusive.
The number of vertices in each graph is between 2 and 200000, inclusive.
The number of edges in each graph is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is n(n-1)/2 or the number of undirected edges, whichever is smaller.
Each edge is either undirected (t_i = 0) or directed (t_i = 1).
Each edge connects two vertices between 1 and n, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: No self-loops (edges from a vertex to itself) or multiple edges (for each pair (x_i, y_i) there are no other pairs (x_i, y_i) or (y_i, x_i)).
preconditions.description: The graph does not contain self-loops or multiple edges.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'NO' if it is impossible to direct the undirected edges to form a directed acyclic graph, or 'YES' followed by m lines describing the directed edges of the resulting graph.

postconditions.expression: Output is 'YES' if and only if the graph can be directed to be acyclic.
postconditions.description: The output 'YES' indicates that there exists a way to direct the undirected edges such that the resulting graph is acyclic.
The output graph must not contain any directed cycles.
All edges in the output graph must be directed.

invariants.expression: The sum of all n over all test cases does not exceed 200000.
invariants.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200000.

invariants.expression: The sum of all m over all test cases does not exceed 200000.
invariants.description: The total number of edges across all test cases does not exceed 200000.
